current_supply_observations.method: Dashboard reports RLUSD obligations from a rippled node and states its data is checked against XRPScan.

current_supply_observations.observed_age: crawled approximately four days before 2026-11-01; exact capture time unavailable
current_supply_observations.warning: Do not use as a same-time comparison with the November 1 XRPL observations.
Two days older than the November 1 XRPL observations; no November 1 global circulation figure was verified.

supply_assessment.confirmed: Two current independent aggregators place XRPL RLUSD outstanding near $708M-$712M on November 1. DefiLlama reports XRPL stablecoin market cap down 24.55% over seven days.
supply_assessment.unresolved: The full disposition of the recent XRPL supply reduction is not traced. It may include cross-chain migration, redemption, issuer inventory movement, or provider corrections.
supply_assessment.cross_chain_migration_claim: Two secondary observations support cross-chain migration as a real mechanism: Coindaro's October 28 analysis reports approximately 25M RLUSD leaving XRPL with a similar amount appearing on Ethereum between October 27-28 while total supply stayed broadly flat; TokenPost documents a matched 1,363,614.85 RLUSD burn on XRPL and mint on Ethereum seconds later on September 6. These observations do not reconcile the full October 28-November 1 XRPL supply reduction.

payment_quality_observation.dust_cluster_assessment: Bitquery analysis attributes 7.79M sub-1 RLUSD payments to a cluster of approximately 110 wallets and three collector wallets. Funding from Binance-labeled wallets does not establish Binance ownership or operation.
limitations: Bitquery is a commercial analytics provider; the article is a public analyst investigation, not issuer reporting.
Wallet clustering is an inference based on transaction/funding patterns; beneficial ownership is unknown.
The $7.33B is gross transfer value, not net external capital or new XRP demand.
Issuer mint/redeem and round-trip activity can inflate gross volume; do not subtract these components into a claimed net figure without transaction-level reconciliation.
payment_quality_observation.source_independence: One Bitquery-based investigation; not independently reproduced from a second raw-ledger dataset in this run.

institutional_payment_rail.capability: RLUSD on XRPL integrated into Cross River's proprietary Core Operating System; fintechs can access RLUSD payments through a single API, move between USD and RLUSD, and support cross-border settlement and treasury movement.
unknowns: No customer count, transaction volume, average ticket, settlement value or XRP bridge usage disclosed.
The Bitquery observation window overlaps only the first few days after the announcement; no causal attribution is established.

limitations: The original public X post was not independently accessible during this run.
No denominator of total XRPL DEX trades was provided.
246,000 XRP is gross routed swap flow, not net XRP acquired or held.
Auto-bridging can use XRP transiently and does not establish lasting inventory demand.
Dated pool snapshot, not current liquidity.
Pool depth is not total XRPL stablecoin supply or all XRP trading depth.
No current slippage curve or LP concentration captured.
notes: At the Sept. 11 snapshot, tracked XRPL DEX volume was $253.1M over 30 days and $30.6M over seven days.
CryptoSlate states that the dataset does not reveal the share of trades routed through XRP or how long liquidity providers retain XRP.
The pool is one observed venue, not necessarily the largest XRP/RLUSD pool.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: A material share of RLUSD supply has moved from XRPL to Ethereum or other networks.
support: October 20 Japanese analysis reports 52.1M moved to Ethereum.
XRPL outstanding near $712M on November 1 versus a stale approximately $982M snapshot four days earlier.
DefiLlama reports a 24.55% seven-day XRPL stablecoin market-cap decline.
Coindaro reports a 25M XRPL-to-Ethereum supply shift on October 27-28 with total supply broadly flat; TokenPost documents a matched XRPL burn/Ethereum mint transaction pair on September 6.
disconfirming: No complete November 1 Ethereum supply observation or end-to-end bridge transaction reconciliation.
Redemptions and provider corrections remain plausible.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Some XRPL RLUSD reduction represents global redemptions rather than chain migration.
support: Issuer redemption activity was material in the Bitquery 30-day sample.
disconfirming: No November 1 global circulation figure or full reserve/mint/burn reconciliation.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Some of the apparent supply change may reflect aggregator methodology or stale-cache correction.
support: DefiLlama asset-page snapshot is stale and differs from current chain-page and XRPL Dashboard values.
disconfirming: Current DefiLlama and XRPL Dashboard agree within roughly 0.6%, supporting the current $708M-$712M range.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross River integration and large-value RLUSD transfers indicate a growing institutional settlement rail.
support: Official Cross River integration announced October 15 with limited-state availability.
Bitquery reports 14,600 payments >=1 RLUSD and $7.33B gross value.
disconfirming: Transfer value is concentrated among ten senders; issuer and round-trip activity inflate gross totals; no Cross River volume disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Stablecoin and token-to-token routing creates measurable transient XRP bridge use.
support: Secondary report of 11,009 bridge trades and 246,000 XRP in one week.
disconfirming: No trade denominator, no net XRP holdings, no current pool depth; gross routed flow is not capital inflow.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL supports real AI-agent micropayment use cases, but high transaction counts can coexist with low token settlement value.
support: XRPL AI Hub reported 4,491,820 transactions with 5,836.71 XRP and 4,125.29 RLUSD settled in a September 8 snapshot.
disconfirming: Single application dashboard; no current throughput, unique payer, merchant revenue or agent count verified.
The reported settled value is only about $11.8K at the article's XRP reference price.

data_model_requirements: issuer obligations and trustline supply by chain
bridge burn/mint mapping across XRPL and Ethereum
gross transfers versus net external flows
AMM pool depth, slippage and LP concentration
Cross River integration usage if publicly disclosed
AI-agent payment count, unique payer/agent/merchant count, median and total settled value, fee-adjusted value, repeat rate and x402 application attribution
next_actions: Reconcile XRPL RLUSD supply at exact ledger indices around October 28-November 1.
Map RLUSD issuer burns, bridge locks/mints and Ethereum supply changes; distinguish migration from redemption.
Reproduce Bitquery's dust and round-trip analysis from public ledger data or an independent provider before treating it as confirmed.
Capture Cross River usage only from public/authorized disclosures.
Track current XRP/RLUSD AMM pool depth and auto-bridging route volume with denominators.

ai_agent_payment_case.use_case: x402-style AI-agent micropayments for API calls, inference and digital services
limitations: The dashboard is not an official Ripple or Circle product.

At the article's reference prices ($1.40 XRP and $1.00 RLUSD), the reported settlement is approximately $12.3K. The transaction count is not equivalent to economic value; it is an application-level micropayment counter.
Agent count, unique payer count, merchant revenue, recurring use and current throughput were not independently verified.
This is a dated application-level snapshot, not total XRPL AI-agent payment volume.
